task_definition.task_description: Please check the weather in Tokyo and convert 22°C to Fahrenheit, then book flight CA1234 for Alex Chen in economy. After that, scan my living room devices and pick the smart lock, check the status of the bedroom AC and prepare and restart it if needed, then turn on the living room light to 35% brightness, and finally create a high-priority app note for user u_alex titled "Travel readiness and home device prep" with the content "Flight booked successfully" and tags travel, iot, and predeparture.

user_input.query: Please check the weather in Tokyo and convert 22°C to Fahrenheit. Then book flight CA1234 for Alex Chen in economy. After that, scan my living_room devices and select the smart lock, check the status of the bedroom AC with device_id ac_bedroom, and if needed, prepare it and restart it. Also turn on the living room light with device ID light_living to 35% brightness. Finally, create a high-priority app note for user u_alex titled “Travel readiness and home device prep” with the content “Flight booked successfully” and the tags travel, iot, and predeparture.
